nodes.label: Compile-From-Source Launcher
nodes.rationale: The launcher compiles cli/ from source on every invocation so no stale binary can drift: a static binary once left the daemon executing weeks-old send-message and bubble-lint code after the source changed. Go's build cache keeps unchanged rebuilds under a second, and telegram daemon restart bounces the daemon onto a fresh build with the watchdog going down and up with it so two pollers can never race into a Telegram 409.

nodes.label: Telegram Daemon Watchdog
nodes.rationale: telegram-watchdog.sh restarts the daemon if it dies, independent of the agent loop, so the channel self-heals even while the agent is busy or mid-restart; rate-limited with backoff and drops a notification when it acts. Especially important when Telegram is the primary or only channel.
